finding: Neonates who required resuscitation, were delivered by assisted vaginal or normal delivery, or had fetal distress as an indication for cesarean section had significantly higher CB TSH levels.
mod_finding: Neonates who had fetal distress or non-progress of labor had significantly higher CB TSH than those delivered by elective cesarean section.
gest_age: Mentioned as a factor analyzed but no specific range provided
